questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of cyber security?

options.text: To make the internet faster for users
To protect devices, data, and online accounts from digital threats
To create new social media platforms
To design better video games

correct_answer.text: To protect devices, data, and online accounts from digital threats

questions.question_text: Why is digital safety especially important for teens in their everyday life?

options.text: Teens spend a lot of time online, increasing their exposure to risks
Teens don’t use the internet as much as adults
Teens are not allowed to use social media
Digital safety only matters for schoolwork

correct_answer.text: Teens spend a lot of time online, increasing their exposure to risks

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of a common digital risk?

options.text: Using a strong password for your accounts
Clicking on a fake email link that asks for your login details
Updating your device software regularly
Sharing only with trusted friends on social media

correct_answer.text: Clicking on a fake email link that asks for your login details

questions.question_text: What is a specific cyber threat that often targets teenagers on social media?

options.text: Updating privacy settings
Cyberbullying through mean comments or rumors
Using two-factor authentication
Posting only educational content

correct_answer.text: Cyberbullying through mean comments or rumors

questions.question_text: What can happen if you overshare personal information on social media as a teen?

options.text: Your account becomes more popular
Strangers might track you or misuse your information
Your privacy settings automatically improve
You get more followers instantly

correct_answer.text: Strangers might track you or misuse your information
